## 2024-05-22 - [ASCII Bar Charts in CLI Reports]
**Learning:** Adding simple ASCII bar charts (e.g., `████░░`) to markdown reports instantly makes distribution data scannable without needing external tools.
**Action:** Use this pattern for all CLI-generated frequency reports (logs, stats, analytics).

## 2024-05-22 - [Table of Contents in Generated Reports]
**Learning:** Large generated reports are hard to navigate. Adding a TOC and "Back to Top" links significantly improves usability.
**Action:** Always include auto-generated TOC for reports > 2 sections.
